releases.legal_basis: Section 251 (ECC 1-06 (d)/2011) is in place for the flow of identifiable data to and from the HSCIC.

Approval for ONS Mortality data has been granted by the Office for National Statistics under the Statistics and Registration Service Act 2007 section 42(4) for the purposes of assisting the Secretary of State for Health or the Welsh Ministers in the performance of his or their functions in relation to the Health Service.
Section 251 (ECC 1-06 (d)/2011) is in place for the flow of identifiable data to and from the HSCIC.

texts.61f5e37c2c63: The following audits collect data and will use data of death data obtained from the NHS IC. Any additional audits must be immediately notified to the NHS IC. Myocardial Ischaemia National Audit (MINAP) Adult Cardiac Convention (SCTS) Congenital Heart Disease Heart Failure Cardiac Rythym Management Audit (31/03/2012) the data will be used for audit purposes only and not research. Data access is restricted to those named in section 7 of this agreement. any changes will be notified to the NHS IC.
